description: Optional provider API connections used to read customer-scoped service health notices.
documentation: Store only non-secret provider scope fields and the ID of an AppEngine-scoped Dynatrace Credential Vault entry. Provider secrets must remain in Credential Vault and must never be copied into this setting.

connectionKey.description: Stable key generated from the provider and account scope identifier.

accountId.description: Non-secret AWS account identifier verified with STS when the connection is tested.

subscriptionId.description: Non-secret Azure subscription identifier used to scope Service Health events.

tenancyId.description: Non-secret tenancy identifier used to scope OCI Announcements.

region.description: Commercial OCI region that hosts the tenancy Announcements endpoint.

credentialId.description: ID of a provider-specific Token credential. The secret remains in Dynatrace Credential Vault.
